_about: Every word the page shows that is not the story (story.json), a name in another data file, or a Codex line (written by crates/core/src/codex.rs from the game's numbers). Mechanical text here (controls, hints, buttons) carries no voice. {placeholders} are filled by the core or the page.
title: Long Time Comin'
subtitle: Sentenced to stop yourself. Delivered fifty years early.
holding_text: A bench, a lamp, and a clerk who writes everything down and has never been seen to blink. Clemency is the only coin the court accepts.
no_counts: No count has been read yet.
map_hint: Tab, M or Esc closes the map. Solid lines are the main path; dashed lines are side paths, which end in the reward shown.
abandon_confirm: Abandon: it counts as a death
hint_arrival: W A S D move · mouse aims · hold left mouse to fire · Space jumps · Shift dashes · walk into the lit gate to leave
hint_fight: Orbs deal damage on contact. Ground waves deal damage unless you are above them: jump them, or stand on something. You take no damage early in a dash.
hint_cleared: Arena cleared. Blue gates continue the main path. Orange gates lead to a side path: harder fights, and the reward shown over the gate.
hint_rest: Choose one: walk to the left pedestal for health, or the right one for its reward, and press E. The other is lost. The gate leads to the boss.
callout_recess: RECESS. THE BLOW IS STRUCK FROM THE RECORD.
callout_fell: FELL: RETURNED TO THE LAST FLOOR
callout_jump_full: ALREADY AT FOUR JUMPS: HEALTH RESTORED
no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, which the game needs to draw.
controls: Aim. The camera turns with it.
Jump. Press again in the air for each further jump you have, up to {max_jumps}.
Dash {dash_distance} m in {dash_time} s. No damage for the first {dash_iframes} s. Uses a charge; each recharges in {dash_recharge} s.
Take a gun from the floor within {pickup_reach} m. Your old gun is left in its place.
Grappling hook, once the Writ of Reach is bought. Range {grapple_range} m.
Parry, once Objection is bought. Lasts {parry_window} s and turns back gold orbs.
Open or close the map. The game is paused while it is open.
credit: Made by Sam Gilson. Art drawn in TikZ.
save_note: Your record is kept in this browser.
first_grant: The clerk grants {n} Clemency for a first offence.
sentence_bonus_applied: Your sentence adds {n}% to the Clemency you earn.
sentence_bonus: Sentence bonus: +{n}% Clemency earned (5% for each 10 years).
callout_pierce: PIERCING ROUNDS: SHOTS PASS THROUGH ONE MORE ENEMY
callout_pulse: DASH PULSE: DASHING CLEARS NEARBY ORBS
callout_mend: MENDING PARRY: TURNED ORBS HEAL YOU
prompt_choose: E: take {thing}. The other choice here is lost.
